digest.component_or_area: plan review criteria vocabulary and ticket schema
propositions: The rebar plan vocabulary maintains two separate headings—Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria—for semantically identical concepts, causing criteria under SC to be miscounted, uncheckoutable, and silently judged against the codebase bar rather than the marking bar.
All criteria-evaluating gates (F1, G3, G7, completion verifier) apply a single unified bar to both SC and AC regardless of heading, proving the split is vestigial and carries no semantic load.

Collapsing SC into AC is now affordable because ADR 0053 grandfathered registry drift at the claim gate, making the migration window viable where it previously invalidated ~632 outstanding attestations.

The collapse must rename detector regexes, reviewer prompts, criteria routing indexes, author guides, generated documentation, eval specs, test fixtures, and 106 live store tickets from SC bullets to AC checkboxes while preserving three permanent exclusions: plan_review_T2.md (experiment metrics), dod_uncertifiable definitions in verifier prompts and verify_models.py, and O-RAN-SC occurrences.
